title: Advanced Explosions Recipes (Unofficial Addon)
description: Adds survival crafting recipes for Advanced Explosions.
body:
This datapack adds survival crafting recipes for Advanced Explosions items.

**Requires Advanced Explosions:**
https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-explosions

**Compatibility:**
Compatible with JEI and REI.

**Troubleshooting:**
If the mod doesn't work, download a datapack loader like Open Loader.

**Credits:**
All credit for the original mod goes to Tracats787.

This is an unofficial addon datapack and does not include the original mod files.
